question: GEO says 91 samples from 16 genotypes, but 19 genotype labels are deposited (10 inbreds incl. B73, 9 B73 hybrids). Which 16 were used in the paper's models is not stated. Keep all 19?
proposed_answer: Keep all; FR1064 (no highN) cannot enter a within-genotype N contrast; decide at contrasts.tsv.
evidence: GSE152249 overall design; per-genotype highN/lowN counts: B73 3/3; B73xIHP1 3/1; B73xILP1 3/2; B73xLH82 3/2; B73xMo17 3/1; B73xMo18W 3/2; B73xOh7B 3/2; B73xPH207 3/3; B73xPHG47 3/2; B73xPHG84 2/2; FR1064 0/1; IHP1 3/3; ILP1 2/2; IRHP1 1/1; LH82 3/3; Mo17 2/3; PH207 3/4; PHG84 3/3; W22 3/2

question: Only some genotype x N groups have 3 replicates; unbalanced genotypes: B73xIHP1, B73xILP1, B73xLH82, B73xMo17, B73xMo18W, B73xOh7B, B73xPHG47, B73xPHG84, FR1064, ILP1, IRHP1, Mo17, PH207, W22. Several arms have a single library (e.g. B73xIHP1 lowN, B73xMo17 lowN, IRHP1 both). Fit per-genotype contrasts only where both arms have >= 2 reps, else pool via genotype + N model?
proposed_answer: Per-genotype log2FC where each arm has >= 2 libraries; otherwise include only in a pooled ~ genotype + N model.
evidence: GEO titles (replicate numbers have gaps, e.g. Rep1 and Rep3 only)

question: PH207 lowN has Rep3 (GSM4610060) and Rep3-2 (GSM4610059), both separate libraries labelled replicate 3. Technical duplicate or a 4th plant?
proposed_answer: Treat as a technical duplicate of Rep3: merge counts with Rep3 or drop Rep3-2 at QC (both rows kept here with replicate 3).
evidence: GEO titles PH207_lowN_Rep3 / PH207_lowN_Rep3-2; SRR11993798 / SRR11993797

question: Split-plot design pairs N-replete and N-depleted rows within main plots, so replicate numbers may mark field blocks shared by highN and lowN. Not confirmed. Model block?
proposed_answer: Do not model block unless the authors confirm; note as possible pairing.
